sam_product: Add explainer for q4_legacy, recommended workloads, and suggested eval prompts.

lena_design: I'll prepare hero image and social tiles. Avoid specific latency numbers in copy.

release-bot: Canary scheduled at 1765554322 (10:00 PT). Pre-launch reminder set for 1765554480.

maria_marketing: Timeline recap: EOD tomorrow—final changelog. Tomorrow noon—docs live. Mon AM—assets. Tue 10:00 PT—announce + canary. Wed—webinar invite. Flag blockers here. :thumbsup:
